messages:
sophia_csm: Quick weekly health check — focusing on error breakdown (5xx, timeouts, rate limits) + the top failing endpoints for accounts flagged for renewal risk. Posting the short summary and action items.

emily_cs: thanks — can you paste the top-5 endpoints and percent error split?

sophia_csm: sure — pulled from the last 7 days across flagged accounts (account cohort: enterprise-trial, high-usage, orgs with support tickets). TL;DR: 5xx up 2.3% w/w, timeouts up 1.1%, rate-limit rejects steady but concentrated in two tenants. Top failing endpoints (by failure count):
- /v1/generate (45% of failures) — mostly 5xx OOM and 504s when seq_len > 4096
- /v1/embeddings (18%) — intermittent 5xx from quantized variant on g4dn pools
- /v1/chat/stream (12%) — timeouts on long-lived streaming sessions (~>2 min)
- /v1/rerank (9%) — rate-limit 429s from burst traffic during nightly jobs
- /v1/batch/predict (6%) — mixed 5xx and connection resets during autoscale events

raj_eng: raw spike graphs? can you share thresholds / sample query sizes?

sophia_csm: attaching quick snippets and a sample trace. sample query for /v1/generate that's triggering OOM: ```
{"model":"redwood-xl-q8_0","input":"<~6k tokens prompt>...","max_tokens":1024}
```
we're seeing GPU OOMs when prefix+gen > ~6500 tokens on some machines.

noah_sre: ops-bot shows a cluster of model-variant restarts around 2026-02-14 03:20 UTC that coincide with the 5xx spike. probable kernel regression on quantized runtime. I'll open infra ticket.

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1149 — Model runtime restarts on g4dn-quantized pool (linked).

liam_support: two renewal-target customers reported timeouts yesterday during demo windows. They hit /v1/chat/stream and lost a conversation. Both were on dedicated capacity with burst enabled.

emily_cs: do we have mitigation suggestions before infra fixes? can we route them to a fallback model or lower max_tokens?

raj_eng: temporary mitigations we can roll out today:
- auto-fallback to non-quantized variant for requests with seq_len > 4096 for affected customers (policy-level)
- enforce soft limit on max_tokens for hosted default to 512 for flagged tenants
- increase prefix KV cache retention for chat streams to reduce recompute cost

I'll draft a canary config and a rollout plan.

sophia_csm: thanks. can you include a conditional rate-limit bump for those two tenants to avoid 429s during demos? liam, can you confirm tenant IDs?

liam_support: confirmed tenants: ACME-Enterprises (tenant_id: t-acme-19) and NovoHealth (t-novo-04). They also run nightly batch reranks that caused 429s on /v1/rerank.

noah_sre: action items from infra side:
- [NOAH] open INC and link to runtime team (INC-2026-1149) — in progress
- [RAJ] prepare fallback policy + canary (target: 2 hours)
- [OPS] throttle/route batch jobs off peak for the two tenants (coord with support)
- [SOPHIA/EMILY] notify customers with short mitigation steps and ETA

emily_cs: will draft customer note now. short version: apology + suggested temporary config (lower max_tokens, enable non-quantized fallback) + offer guided session.

raj_eng: sample canary config (will upload to infra-config repo): ```
# canary: fallback-nonquantized-for-long-seqs
match:
  tenant_ids: ["t-acme-19","t-novo-04"]
  seq_len_gt: 4096
action:
  route_to_model: "redwood-xl-compat"
  priority: high
  rollout: 10% -> 50% -> 100% (30m intervals)
```

sophia_csm: Perf notes: expect latency to increase ~10-20% for routed requests but 5xx should drop to near-zero. Please include that in the customer note.

ops-bot: Reminder: scheduled maintenance on quantized pools 2026-02-15 04:00 UTC.

liam_support: I'll set up two demo windows for the customers and coordinate the canary with Raj.

emily_cs: draft customer message posted to thread (short): "We're seeing elevated 5xx/timeout rates for some long sequences. We've scheduled a mitigation (automatic fallback to a non-quantized variant for long requests) that will be canaried within 2 hours. Expect slightly higher latency but drastically lower 5xx. Support will schedule a guided session to minimize disruption. — Emily" :thumbsup:

raj_eng: rolling out canary now to 10% for the two tenants. logs: ```
[2026-02-14T10:12:03Z] canary rollout start: fallback-nonquantized-for-long-seqs -> 10% (t-acme-19,t-novo-04)
[2026-02-14T10:12:45Z] route hits: 12; errors decreased from 38 -> 4 in sampled window
```

noah_sre: early signal looks good. continue to monitor for 30m and then advance to 50%. I'll also coordinate with kernel team re: regression.

sophia_csm: thanks team. follow-ups: update renewal playbook with this troubleshooting checklist, add a quick pointer in enablement onboarding to avoid demos hitting >4k seqs, and reconvene next week if errors don't fully normalize.

emily_cs: noted. I'll put a calendar reminder and create a short KB entry.

liam_support: closing loop with customers after guided sessions.

sophia_csm: closing note: current status — canary in progress, 5xx rolling down for sample traffic, support engaged with renewal-risk customers. Will post final numbers in 24h. :white_check_mark:

end of thread.
